itens.trecho: "Suzume" is cycling to school one morning when she encounters a strange young man who asks her for directions to the nearest ruin! She sends him off in the direction of a dilapidated complex and continues her journey. Gradually, though, she begins to wonder who he was and what he was up to.

The various meanings of Suzume, a journey throughout Japan, to say goodbye to abandoned places, since there is a tradition there of the jichin-sai or inauguration ceremony before the beginning of construction, but not for closing, together with the metaphor of earthquakes, the teleportation reminded me of the wonderful Your Name, I expected a greater drama…

With a compelling story, jaw-dropping animation and impressive action sequences, Suzume is a contender for Makoto Shinkai’s most thrilling and enjoyable film to date. It’s an uninterrupted adventure with relentless twists and turns and no brakes.
